name: What's-included tabbed slider
purpose: Shows every product module included in the plan, one slide per module, with a quote for reassurance and a demo CTA.
description: Page-local block for /whats-included. Split header: H2 + grey lead on the left, an italic quote card (avatar, name, role) on the right (stacks <=767). Then a loop slider of full-width slides, each a large rounded panel with an offset 1440:873 product image, a bottom gradient and the module name (H3) + paragraph pinned bottom-left; the tab row sits BELOW the slider (4.75rem; <=767 two per row, 3.5rem). A centred primary CTA follows.
